annotations.title: France severance pay: dismissal and mutual termination (indemnité de licenciement, rupture conventionnelle)

description: French severance pay for a CDI, 2026: statutory dismissal indemnity (indemnité de licenciement) or minimum rupture conventionnelle amount (seniority counted like the Labour Ministry simulator, full-time parental leave counted half), then the tax and social split of the amount paid: tax-exempt part, contribution base, CSG/CRDS, net, 40% employer levy. Use when a user is dismissed, negotiates a rupture conventionnelle, or an employer budgets a departure in France: minimum amount due, how much is tax-free, how much CSG/CRDS is withheld, and the employer cost. Deterministic code, no LLM. Seniority and statutory amounts match the Labour Ministry simulator (code.travail.gouv.fr) on 15 recorded cases, including its exact month counting; the tax and social split reproduces every worked example of the official social security doctrine (BOSS) and service-public.fr; 2026 parameters (PASS 48,060 EUR, 40% levy from the 2026 social security financing act) are sourced. Not supported (refused for free with HTTP 422): end of fixed-term or temp contracts, serious misconduct (faute grave, answered for free: no statutory indemnity), occupational unfitness, redundancy plans (PSE) and redeployment leave, retirement, mixed full-time/part-time careers, collective agreement formulas (the agent supplies the branch amount), contracts ending outside 2026, amounts above 10 PASS. Price: 0.02 USDC per successful call, paid with x402 over MCP. Missing or invalid fields are reported for free with the questions to ask the user; you never pay for an error. Returns JSON (also in structuredContent): calculateur, resultat, detail (step by step), hypotheses, bareme (version, effective date, sources), estimation_indicative, avertissement, lien_verification. Full output schema and a real example: list_france_calculators.

absences_non_comptees.description: Absences of a month or more that do not count toward seniority, as a list of {motif, duree_mois (whole months)}; empty list if none. motif: maladie_non_professionnelle, accident_de_trajet, conge_sabbatique, conge_creation_entreprise, conge_parental_temps_plein (counted half), conge_sans_solde, greve, mise_a_pied.

alternance_temps_plein_partiel.description: True if the employee alternated full-time and part-time periods (refused for free).

annee_versement.description: Optional: year the indemnity is paid. Default: year of the contract end; only 2026 is supported.

cadre_licenciement_economique.description: Required for economic dismissal: hors_pse, csp (security contract), pse or conge_reclassement (both refused).

date_entree.description: Contract start date YYYY-MM-DD (first fixed-term contract if it was followed by the CDI without interruption).

date_fin_contrat.description: Contract end date YYYY-MM-DD: end of notice period (theoretical end if notice was waived by the employer, for non-occupational unfitness or CSP), or the termination date set in the rupture conventionnelle. Must be in 2026.

date_notification.description: Required for licenciement: date the dismissal letter was sent, YYYY-MM-DD (the 8-month seniority condition is checked at this date).

droit_pension_retraite.description: Required for rupture_conventionnelle: true if, at the termination date, the employee is entitled to claim a pension from a mandatory basic scheme (fully taxable then).

indemnite_conventionnelle_branche.description: Severance amount in EUR set by the industry-wide collective agreement if higher than the statutory one, or "aucune" (none), or "inconnue" (unknown: only the statutory minimum is returned, without the tax and social split).

indemnite_versee.description: Optional: gross amount actually paid or negotiated, EUR. Default: the minimum due.

montant_specifique_branche_rupture_conve.description: Optional, rupture_conventionnelle: specific amount set by the branch agreement for mutual termination, if any (used for the CSG/CRDS threshold).

motif_licenciement.description: Required for licenciement: personnel, economique, inaptitude_non_professionnelle, inaptitude_professionnelle (refused) or faute_grave_ou_lourde (answered for free: no statutory indemnity).

primes_annuelles_3_derniers_mois.description: Total annual or exceptional bonuses included in the last 3 salaries (0 if none); counted as 1/12 per month.

remuneration_brute_annee_precedente.description: Gross pay received in the calendar year before the termination, EUR (0 if none). Not needed when the branch amount is unknown.

salaires_mensuels_bruts.description: Gross monthly salaries including bonuses, oldest to most recent: the 12 months before the dismissal notice (rupture conventionnelle: before the end of the contract), or all months worked if fewer; months before a sick leave if any.

secteur_hors_ani.description: Required for rupture_conventionnelle with a branch amount: true if the employer is agricultural, a liberal profession, social economy, health and social sector, or a private household (minimum is then the statutory amount).

type_rupture.description: licenciement (dismissal of a CDI employee), rupture_conventionnelle (mutual termination of a CDI), or fin_cdd_ou_interim (refused for free).
